author: gtasixinfo
text:
Everything you need to know about the GTA 6 Limited Edition DualSense controllers:

- The controllers are priced at $84.99 / €84.99 / £74.99 each.

- Pre-orders begin September 10th at 7:00am PT/10:00am ET in the U.S.

- Both the black and white versions launch on November 19 alongside GTA 6.

- The design features GTA 6 branding across the touchpad with purple and blue accents inspired by Vice City.

text:
Cyberleek is finished.

The coin lost 96% of its value following the GTA 6 Extended Look, and the group has apparently cashed out nearly $270k they made from trading fees.

Take-Two remains on the hunt for the group, but no one knows if they’ll ever catch them.

author: gta6plus
text:
Take-Two has not said it knows the identities of 2 people behind the recent GTA 6 leaks, despite several reports claiming it does.

What it has identified are 2 Discord accounts it believes may be involved. It is asking Discord for information that could reveal who is actually behind them.

A judge approved that request, but the target account details are being kept private. Neither account has been confirmed as Cyberleek. (via @torrentfreak)
